review.checksum_scope: Native timing checks instruction boundaries, rejections and selected consumed output values. This full-library driver does not run unit tests. Eight native owner units per binary were checked in the separate pilot, and the eleven-configuration job runs its own registered unit checks. The separate local active-path probe compares complete cs_insn/cs_detail records, untouched bytes, cursors and errors for 162398208 inputs and guarded-page extents. These are distinct validation surfaces.

protocol_correction.reason: Correct a copied pilot-only unit-test claim. No timing code, data, source patch or run changed.

review.scope: Full library corpus: two active Clang versions, ten common-boundary panels, three modes, two launch controls, 21 paired cycles; four other compiler/host profiles retain identical runtime objects and binaries. Actual NeverD product qualification remains separate.
